The Owner's words of 2026-10-07, `ข้อ 4 mw`, read by A0 as 'item 4: do it' (evidence/WP-0A-DB-00/product-owner-disposition-2026-10-07-rfc-025-s6.md); the reading is A0's (RFC header line). They direct writing the proposal, not its adoption.
assumptions: A0's reading of `ข้อ 4 mw` as 'item 4: do it' is right. If it is not, the PR is withdrawn. The Owner's answer to Q-025-6-1 settles it.
An approved RFC is amended in its own text, as §5 was; the repository has no rule requiring a new RFC number for an amendment.
WP-0A-DB-00 owns RFC-2026-025 and scripts/db/**, so the classifier lives in scripts/db/ (RFC §6.6 item 4 offers a protocol path if the Owner prefers).
The CI checkout keeps full history (fetch-depth: 0); the new test builds its own throwaway git repository and does not depend on this tree's history.

security_privacy_cost_impact: No secret, credential, tenant data, provider or database is touched. The classifier reads git objects only, with argument arrays (no shell), literal pathspecs and no network. The test builds a throwaway repository under the OS temp directory with a synthetic author that is not an e-mail address, and removes it. Cost: §6, if adopted, replaces four role runs with one reading on records-only PRs and removes carry readings on mechanical syncs. No token or time figure is claimed.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No migration, policy, grant, probe or catalog change.
compatibility_impact: Tests 716 -> 717 (one in foundation-contract): floor 86 -> 87, name digest and assertion floor (1121 -> 1320 -> 1329, the guard's own count) moved in scripts/test-suite-contract.mjs; evidence/VERIFICATION.md written by the record script's render() (717). No behaviour of any existing guard changes: §6 is text until the Owner decides, and the classifier is run by hand, not by CI.
known_limitations: The classifier decides the SHAPE of a diff by file name, not its content: a records-transcription-*.md or session-*.md file can carry Owner words from chat, or a role verdict not yet on main, and exit 0 (A1-7, C0 N1). The reader of §6.2 is the only check; the one-sentence fix in §6.2 or the Owner's acceptance by name is owed.

A light-path reading is not bound to the head it read; a later commit is not refused by any script (R0 R2-1, advisory). §6.1's 'wider in four places' list does not name a new open_blockers entry (R0 R2-2).
A mechanical sync can still interact semantically with main (a validator the PR's records are judged by); §6.3 leaves that to CI on the final head.
The classifier script is not itself digested in test-kits/integrity-manifest.json; its test is (RFC §6.6 item 2).
CI does not run the classifier (RFC §6.6 item 1).
